recipes.title: Tomato Egg Toast
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs and pan-sweetened tomato piled on crisp toast.
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Dice the tomato and cook in a pan with a little butter until softened, 3 minutes.
Push tomato aside, scramble the eggs in the same pan until just set.
Season with salt and pepper, pile onto the toast.
tips: Add chili flakes for a kick.
Swap bread for a tortilla to make it a wrap.

recipes.title: Masala French Toast
recipes.description: Savory Indian-style French toast with onion, chili, and coriander.
instructions: Whisk eggs with finely chopped onion, chili, and salt.
Dip bread slices in the mixture, coating both sides.
Pan-fry in hot oil until golden on both sides.
Serve warm with ketchup or chutney.
tips: Add chopped coriander for freshness.

recipes.title: Spicy Egg Sandwich
recipes.description: A quick, satisfying sandwich with spiced fried eggs.
instructions: Fry the eggs to your liking, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Spread mayonnaise on bread, layer onion and tomato slices.
Add the fried egg and a dash of hot sauce.
Close the sandwich and slice in half.
tips: Toast the bread for extra crunch.

recipes.title: One-Pot Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.description: Creamy, garlicky pasta made entirely in a single pot.
instructions: Melt butter in a pot and saute chopped garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add pasta and just enough water/stock to cover, simmer until al dente.
Stir in cream and parmesan until glossy and thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.
tips: Reserve pasta water to loosen the sauce if needed.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Colorful, high-protein stir-fry with crisp vegetables.
instructions: Slice chicken thinly and marinate briefly with soy sauce.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot pan/wok until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and vegetables until crisp-tender.
Return chicken to the pan, toss with extra soy sauce, and serve hot.
tips: Keep the heat high and don't overcrowd the pan.

recipes.title: Comforting Chicken Soup
recipes.description: A warm, gentle soup that feels like a hug in a bowl.
instructions: Saute onion, carrot, celery, and garlic until soft.
Add chicken and stock, bring to a simmer.
Cook until chicken is tender and vegetables are soft, about 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken back into the pot, season, and serve warm.
tips: Add noodles or rice to make it heartier.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
recipes.description: A wholesome, protein-rich curry that comes together in one pan.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add chopped tomato and cook down into a sauce.
Stir in chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted, season and serve with rice.
tips: Add garam masala for extra warmth.

recipes.title: Fresh Greek Salad
recipes.description: A crisp, refreshing salad with bright Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomato, and onion into bite-size pieces.
Combine in a bowl with olives and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Toss gently and serve chilled.
tips: Let it sit 10 minutes for flavors to meld.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.description: Naturally sweet pancakes made with mashed banana and oats.
instructions: Mash the banana and whisk in eggs and milk.
Stir in oats and a pinch of cinnamon, let sit 5 minutes.
Cook spoonfuls on a hot, lightly oiled pan until bubbles form, then flip.
Serve warm with honey or fruit.
tips: Blend the oats first for a smoother texture.

recipes.title: Yogurt Berry Bowl
recipes.description: A light, cooling bowl that takes minutes to put together.
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, a drizzle of honey, and granola.
Serve immediately.
tips: Use frozen berries in a pinch.

recipes.title: Loaded Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Creamy avocado on crisp toast with a soft egg on top.
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon, salt, and pepper.
Fry or poach an egg to your liking.
Spread avocado on toast, top with the egg and chili flakes.
tips: A poached egg keeps it lighter.

recipes.title: Beef & Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Weeknight tacos loaded with seasoned beef and beans.
instructions: Brown the beef with chopped onion and taco seasoning.
Stir in beans and warm through.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the beef mixture.
Top with cheese and a squeeze of lime.
tips: Add salsa or hot sauce for extra kick.

recipes.title: Simple Fried Rice
recipes.description: A satisfying way to use up leftover rice and whatever's in the fridge.
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a hot pan and set aside.
Stir-fry onion, carrot, and peas until tender.
Add rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry until heated through.
Return eggs to the pan, add soy sauce, and toss to combine.
tips: Day-old rice fries up better than fresh.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Grain Bowl
recipes.description: A wholesome bowl balancing grains, roasted veg, and a bright dressing.
instructions: Roast diced sweet potato and chickpeas with olive oil until golden.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Assemble rice, roasted vegetables, and fresh spinach in a bowl.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and olive oil.
tips: Make a double batch for meal prep.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
recipes.description: The ultimate cozy pairing for a low-energy evening.
instructions: Simmer tomato, onion, and garlic until soft, then blend smooth.
Butter bread slices and fill with cheese.
Grill the sandwich in a pan until golden and the cheese melts.
Serve alongside the warm tomato soup.
tips: A splash of cream makes the soup extra silky.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.description: A two-minute snack that's genuinely satisfying.
instructions: Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter generously.
Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.
tips: Add a pinch of cinnamon for warmth.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp
recipes.description: Bright, punchy shrimp ready in under 15 minutes.
instructions: Melt butter in a hot pan and add minced garlic.
Add shrimp and cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice over and toss with chopped parsley.
Serve with bread or rice to soak up the sauce.
tips: Don't overcook the shrimp — it turns rubbery fast.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Noodles
recipes.description: Quick noodles tossed with crisp vegetables and soy sauce.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions and drain.
Stir-fry garlic, onion, carrot, and cabbage until crisp-tender.
Add noodles and soy sauce, tossing to coat evenly.
Serve hot, garnished with spring onion if you have it.
tips: High heat keeps the vegetables crisp.

recipes.title: Baked Oats with Apple
recipes.description: A warm, filling breakfast bake that needs almost no effort.
instructions: Mix oats, milk, eggs, cinnamon, and honey in a baking dish.
Fold in diced apple.
Bake at 180C/350F for 20-25 minutes until set.
Let cool slightly and serve warm.
tips: Great made ahead and reheated through the week.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka Skillet
recipes.description: Smoky, spiced paneer and peppers cooked in one skillet.
instructions: Marinate paneer and vegetables in yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices for 10 minutes.
Cook in a hot skillet until the paneer is lightly charred.
Add the vegetables and cook until just tender.
Serve with flatbread or rice.
tips: A cast-iron pan gives the best char.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: A silky, deeply savory soup perfect for a slow evening.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add stock and simmer 15 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in cream, season, and serve warm.
tips: Reserve a few sauteed mushrooms to garnish.

recipes.title: Quick Veggie Quesadilla
recipes.description: A crispy, cheesy quesadilla loaded with whatever vegetables you have.
instructions: Saute bell pepper and onion until soft.
Layer cheese, vegetables, and beans on a tortilla, top with another.
Cook in a dry pan until golden and the cheese melts, flipping once.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.
tips: Don't overfill or it won't flip cleanly.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Salmon
recipes.description: A sticky, restaurant-quality glaze on tender salmon.
instructions: Whisk together honey, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp.
Flip, pour the sauce over, and simmer until it thickens and glazes the fish.
Serve with rice or greens.
tips: Baste the salmon with the sauce as it reduces.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Prep it the night before for a grab-and-go breakfast.
instructions: Combine oats, milk, and yogurt in a jar.
Stir in honey and refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries before eating.
Stir well and enjoy cold.
tips: Keeps well in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Spicy Chickpea Bowl
recipes.description: A bold, satisfying bowl for when you want big flavor fast.
instructions: Saute onion until golden, then add chickpeas and chili flakes.
Cook until the chickpeas are slightly crisp.
Serve over rice with chopped tomato and a squeeze of lemon.
Adjust spice to taste.
tips: Smash a few chickpeas for a creamier texture.
